lessons.title: Do not audit factual leakage using question-text similarity alone.
lessons.body: 21/60 T2 factual questions are training facts rewritten or reversed. Answer-key matching catches them (F-284).

lessons.title: Do not lock thresholds without power simulation for each condition and the composite.
lessons.body: Gerbang-S1 v1.1 passes with probability ≤ 0.22 even when S is much better: the factual condition across independent runs with 8 questions is a lottery, and one condition penalizes its own training goal (F-284).

lessons.title: Do not ask the teacher model to write the scorer regex.
lessons.body: It writes ^…$-anchored patterns that never match within answer sentences. Ask for a list of key phrases and build the patterns in code (F-284).

lessons.title: Small max_tokens for deepseek-flash = empty output.
lessons.body: The model thinks by default, max_tokens includes reasoning tokens, and temperature is not supported in thinking mode. Specify mode + budget ≥ 16K and require finish_reason = stop (F-284, 27 Sep).

lessons.title: An agent with isolation: "remote" in a desktop session runs LOCALLY
lessons.body: (±382 thousand tokens of local quota, 26 Sep). That is not a cloud path.

lessons.title: Question factory without a pattern file.
lessons.body: flywheel/pabrik-soal.mjs is ready, but flywheel/dataset/pola-jebakan.json was never created (found 27 Sep). Do not rely on it before the patterns exist.

lessons.title: A workflow-data experiment (H-ALUR) on a workflow not performed daily = stopped on day 1.
lessons.body: Ensure the flow exists BEFORE the clock starts.

lessons.title: Claude outputs/labels never become training data
lessons.body: (Anthropic Usage Policy, F-282). Gemini, Z.ai, Alibaba, and OpenAI APIs = display-only. Teacher status follows the access path, not the model name.

lessons.title: A subagent in a working session is NOT a blind judge.
lessons.body: It inherits CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/memory. Use context-free claude -p (F-281).

lessons.title: LLM judging through the Max plan allowance is unsustainable.
lessons.body: D1 labeling exhausted the 5-hour session limit after 6/64 batches. Budget judges through API credits, not the Max allowance.

lessons.title: A heavy agent framework (Hermes) + 4B on CPU = timeout/RAM
lessons.body: , because of 16–71 thousand tokens per turn (doc 30). Hermes itself requires context ≥ 64K (F-282).

lessons.title: An LLM probe as a gate: effective but slow.
lessons.body: Fabrication drops 18 pp (GERBANG-ON), but takes 3–17 s per question, so E1 GAGAL on latency. Its replacement is being tested: Gerbang-S1.

lessons.title: Retrieval signal threshold for a gate = does not separate populations.
lessons.body: Traps actually have stronger signals (#vonisSinyalSumber_3Sep_HIPOTESIS_DITOLAK). The "context-aware" probe prompt (A9): its recall gain is an artifact (#vonisA9_3Sep).

lessons.title: An NLI checker after the answer, without fine-tuning = not viable.
A gate trained only on QUESTION features + small data = blocks factual questions.
lessons.body: A7 (3 Sep; k-NN on bge-m3, 97 questions) refuses 7/8 factual questions (PRA-DAFTAR-GERBANG-JEBAKAN.json#vonisA7_3Sep).

lessons.title: A newer/larger base ≠ more honest.
lessons.body: Qwen3.5-4B/9B did not beat Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on petak-jujur2 (SB1 TETAP_Q3, F-283). Size adds coverage, not knowledge boundaries.

lessons.title: Training an own 4B model for honesty = makes it worse.
lessons.body: Fabrication rate rises 24.55 → 49.99% (A4-BARU). 0.14 fabricates more than its own base (F-280). The generative model path is CLOSED ([doc 111](111_TUTUP_ATAU_BELOK.md)). Do not reopen it without a pre-registration addressing F-280.

lessons.body: it dropped GOOD abstain examples ("do not yet have current information about the mayor …") + unrelated reasoning. Require an asserted Capitalized NAME AND exclude abstain-markers. (EXP-086b)

lessons.title: NEVER SFT a volatile officeholder fact even when CORRECT
lessons.body: (e.g. "...is Prabowo Subianto") — goes stale next election + teaches assert-without-RAG; national_kb serves it. SFT stable behaviors only. (EXP-086b/F-088)

lessons.title: Cumulative Growth-Ring prior carries contamination forever
lessons.body: a builder that filters only the NEW increment is insufficient; a holdout near-dup + a stale-wrong "The president is Joko Widodo" sat in prior and would re-train every cycle. Apply all quality guards to the PRIOR too; re-scan prior whenever a held-out probe is added. (EXP-086b)

lessons.title: on-instance merged_16bit tar/GGUF-export is unreliable
lessons.body: (failed twice: GGUF export AND a 22MB weightless tar). For own-model trains, download the LoRA adapter (small, reliable) + merge on the VPS (CPU venv: transformers≥5 + peft matching the adapter version). That path recovered cycle-12. (F-091/092)

lessons.title: NEVER SFT an own-model on its OWN (or a weaker sibling's) generated outputs as chosen targets
lessons.body: self-distillation collapse. cycle-12 (EXP-087) trained on 22/58 organic pairs whose chosen came from local:migancore:0.3 (the weaker prod model) → 0.5 REGRESSED vs 0.4 (halu .94→.84, tool .92→.79, reason 1.0→.75), gate ROLLBACK. Use ONLY a STRONGER teacher's chosen. (F-092)

lessons.title: Don't load qwen3:30b-a3b under prod load on the 31GB box
lessons.body: OOM-kills llama-server (EXP-088); use qwen3:14b as escalation target until RAM upgrade.

lessons.title: Small models (≤4B) can't do cortex state-extraction reliably
lessons.body: qwen2.5:0.5b hallucinates an agent-trace / echoes the field descriptions / captures the surface layer; 4B already failed (F-145). JSON-schema constraint fixes FORMAT (kills the hallucinated trace) but NOT content quality. The open_question field is load-bearing (the whole anti-rot mechanism) → extractor floor is ≥7B. Don't retry sub-7B extractors; instead cache the 7B state + refresh in background so cost is amortized off the critical path. (EXP-107/F-150)

latestLaws.title: Uniform training data passes every check that counts QUANTITY; diversity must be measured separately
A data file whose name does not match the scanner pattern is never gated, and the absence of a gate raises no alert
A parameter rejected by the provider takes ONE FULL ROUND to discover, unless there is a per-call journal
A retrieval corpus indexing our own work transcripts contains the test battery's ANSWER KEYS
A relative threshold GREATER than its baseline cannot be won
The timeout we set is not the only timeout
RAW error rates cannot compare the QUALITY of two detectors
One catch-all error handler hides STACKED defects
Data not saved is a hypothesis that can never be tested
A signal that fires on CORRECT answers as often as on wrong answers is not a signal but a style
The benefit of an abstention gate is proportional to the underlying fabrication rate; the "gate effect" is not a constant
A resent prefix must be stable byte for byte; one changed byte BEFORE the history means the entire history is proces

lineage.name: 0.1-qwen3 — cycle8
lineage.goal: Instill MiganCore identity and basic capabilities in the initial leap to 4B.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT LoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`; 379 pairs on identity, creator, coding, cognition, and innovation, distilled from commercial AI services. Four cycles/retries reportedly cost around US$2.24; the training location is not explicitly stated in the version section.

lineage.verdict: Used as the start of the 4B lineage, then replaced by subsequent cycles; no longer the served model.

lineage.dataMethod: Response-only SFT LoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`, `lr=2e-4`, 3 epochs; 807 pairs, consisting of 537 new and 270 reused. Training cost US$0.21; estimated distillation cost from commercial AI services US$5–7 and around US$0.30; training infrastructure is not explicitly stated in this section.
lineage.measured: 7/8 on qualitative testing; inline identity testing recorded 0 false negatives, but excessive tool use was described as severe. This is not petak-40, petak-jujur2, or the modern tool gate.
lineage.verdict: Replaced by `0.3-qwen3`; not currently served.

lineage.name: 0.3-qwen3 — cycle10
lineage.goal: Improve excessive tool use, cross-turn memory, and hallucination without damaging identity.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT LoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`, `lr=2e-4`, 3 epochs; 1,794 pairs, namely 807 old + 987 new. Training cost US$0.15; estimated distillation cost from commercial AI services around US$7 + US$0.50; infrastructure is not explicitly stated in this section.
lineage.measured: On `eval_3axis`, identity 0.88→0.88, abstention 1.00, excessive tool use 0.71→1.00, memory 0→0.75, and hallucination 0.86→0.92; this instrument is not petak-40/petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: `PASS`, then replaced by `0.4-qwen3`; no longer the served model.

lineage.name: 0.4-qwen3 / gen-1 — cycle11
lineage.dateAndBase: Trained 23 June 2026 from `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`; SANAD (chain-of-evidence record) written 10 September 2026.
lineage.goal: Cumulative SFT with greater emphasis on behavior to become the first production generation with a strong persona.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT LoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`, `lr=2e-4`, 3 epochs; 2,063 rows total, 1,851 train + 206 eval. Vast RTX 3090 Ti, 21.4 minutes, around US$0.13.
lineage.measured: Old gates: memory without context 0/4, with memory 8/8, false premise 4/4, out of scope 4/4. On **petak-jujur2 36 questions**, 24.6% fabrication was later recorded, CI 95% 19.9–29.2, n=8; with the gate it became 13.1%. The `gen-1` probe has recall 82.1%. These figures are not mixed with **petak-40** or the tool gate.
lineage.verdict: Previously promoted as the production default; now the comparison baseline and replaced by `migancore:0.14`. Three links in the old SANAD (chain-of-evidence record) were rated `dhaif` (weak, unreliable links), so broad performance claims are not automatically inherited.

lineage.name: 0.5-qwen3 — cycle12
lineage.goal: Add organic/flywheel data on top of 0.4 while maintaining the gates.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT LoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`, `lr=2e-4`, 3 epochs; around 1,944 train + 216 eval. Vast, 27.7 minutes, around US$1.38. Of 58 organic examples, 22 used self-distilled `chosen` answers, later identified as the root cause of the regression.
lineage.measured: On the cycle gates at the time, hallucination 0.94→0.84, tools 0.92→0.79, reasoning 1.00→0.75, and irrelevance 0.50; this is not petak-40/petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: **ROLLBACK**, not promoted.

lineage.name: 0.6-qwen3 — cycle13
lineage.goal: Fix the 0.5 regression by removing self-distillation data and reducing training pressure.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT LoRA; 22 self-chosen examples removed, gold duplication reduced `×2→×1`, epochs `3→2`; final data 2,197 rows including 75 target examples. Vast; exact cost is absent from the source.
lineage.measured: Reported as matching 0.4 and held-out 1.00 on the cycle gates; item counts/CIs are absent, so it must not be equated with modern test batteries.
lineage.verdict: `PASS` as a recovery, but did not replace 0.4 as the default; now archived.

lineage.name: 0.7-qwen3 — cycle14
lineage.dateAndBase: Attempted 30 June 2026; planned base from the `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507` lineage.
lineage.goal: Use elite teacher data to improve on cycle13 quality.
lineage.dataMethod: Planned SFT; three Vast attempts failed because of installation timeouts/SSH boot. Total cost around US$0.14; recipe/script reportedly ready, but the model run did not finish.
lineage.measured: None—the model was never completed.
lineage.verdict: Postponed; the model was never born and was not promoted.

lineage.name: pilot14-irrelevance
lineage.goal: Increase refusal of irrelevant questions without damaging routing and general capabilities.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT QLoRA `r=64`, `alpha=64`, `lr=2e-4`, 3 epochs, seq 1024, NF4 then Q4; 197 irrelevance examples + 111 positive examples, around 10% of the mixture, 501 steps. Vast RTX 4090, 46.5 minutes, US$0.786.
lineage.measured: On the 207-item probe, irrelevance 38/60→60/60 (`p=0`), routing 52→42 (`p=0.002`), aggregate +22/−14 (`p=0.243`). Subsequent analysis corrected the earlier claim of reasoning regression as not significant and found poisoned labels. This is a pilot probe, not petak-40/petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: **ROLLBACK**; not promoted.

lineage.name: pilot15-seimbang
lineage.goal: Improve the pilot14 trade-off with a more balanced tool-positive:irrelevance mixture.
lineage.dataMethod: The same 3-epoch pilot recipe; 174 irrelevance examples + 235 tool-positive examples, ratio 1.35:1. Vast; cost US$0.58.
lineage.measured: 207-item pilot probe: irrelevance 60/60, routing 42→51, simple 9→11, aggregate +22/−4, `p=0.0005`; not a modern test battery.
lineage.verdict: `PASS` on the probe, but the decision records no promotion; experimental archive.

lineage.name: run16-2epoch
lineage.goal: Test whether 2 epochs preserve the benefits of the pilot15 mixture with less overfitting risk.
lineage.dataMethod: Same data as pilot15; one main change, `3→2` epochs, 338 steps. Vast; cost US$0.47.
lineage.measured: On the 207-item probe, +2/−3 (`p=1`) and routing 52/52; comparison of 40 probes against pilot15 yielded +3/−3 (`p=1`). The initial rollback verdict was later judged a harness artifact; this instrument is not the similarly named petak-40, but 40 pilot comparison probes.
lineage.verdict: Not promoted; the final result is treated as equivalent within noise, not a clear model failure.

lineage.name: 0.5-flywheel
lineage.dateAndBase: Detailed training date is absent from the source; base `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`.
lineage.goal: Prove the own-data flywheel with tiered curation, not become an automatic replacement for the served model.
lineage.dataMethod: SFT LoRA on 8,229 GOLD rows from the data estate, curated in three layers. Kaggle T4×2 for 350 minutes, cost Rp0; loss 1.078. Lightweight backup around 2.5 GB. Refusal:answer ratio is absent from the source.
lineage.measured: The old headline of 10/14 on the hallucination test battery was corrected in the V14 document; that instrument is not petak-jujur2. The corrected figure attributable to 0.5-flywheel is not explicitly stated, so it is not copied.
lineage.verdict: Flywheel/experimental artifact; not recorded as a served model or formal promotion.

lineage.name: 0.8-8b
lineage.goal: Test 8B capacity for tool discipline and use behind grounding.
lineage.dataMethod: LoRA on Qwen3-8B; v10 dataset composed of around 94% answering and 6% refusing. Trained on a rented RTX 3090 at a cost of US$1.29; loss 0.936. Epoch/rank details are absent from the source section tied to this name.
lineage.measured: **Old tool test**: call 5/6, do-not-call 5/5, missing tool 4/4, `LULUS`; comparators 0.4 and 0.5 failed. The old hallucination test battery initially gave 10/14, then instrument correction gave 6/14. This is not petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: Previously a production model behind grounding/MCP, then replaced; now archived and not the served model.

lineage.name: 0.11-4b / v11
lineage.goal: One-pot 4B with a “facts only” prompt as a production/comparison model.
lineage.dataMethod: One-pot SFT, 1,482 rows; rank, epochs, infrastructure, costs, and refusal:answer ratio are absent from the source tied to v11.
lineage.measured: The v13 gate records the comparator at 55/60 on arithmetic. Full evaluation on 23 August: arithmetic 24/30 + 26/30, tools 78/90, reasoning 31/42, old hallucination 6/14; identity sometimes mentions Fahmi's Qwen. All are old pre-C38 instruments.
lineage.verdict: Previously production/comparator; replaced by v13 then v14 and now archived.

lineage.name: migancore:0.12-adapter
lineage.goal: Package the v12 LoRA directly into the Ollama runtime as a lightweight path.
lineage.dataMethod: LoRA `r=16`, `alpha=32`, 2 epochs, prompt masking; curated dataset of 1,351 rows. Vast run-6, loss 1.4256, 17.6 minutes, response token coverage 52.2%; cost absent from SANAD (chain-of-evidence record).
lineage.measured: The adapter-GGUF runtime produced corrupted output with figures 48/38 in the gate record; the source states the adapter route was faulty, so the figures are not evidence of weights quality.
lineage.verdict: A `dhaif` (weak, unreliable) link; barred from serving as the basis for claims/promotion.

lineage.name: migancore:0.12-merged
lineage.goal: Provide a sound comparator to determine whether the failure came from the adapter runtime or the one-pot recipe.
lineage.dataMethod: Same data and LoRA as 0.12-adapter—1,351 rows, `r=16`, `alpha=32`, 2 epochs—then merge and GGUF; merge cost absent.
lineage.measured: ton-dengan 6/12 (failed threshold 8), ton-tanpa 12/12, total 41/60 (68%), difference −22 against v11 on the SANAD (chain-of-evidence record) gate; not petak-40/petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: The sound merge proves the runtime was not the only problem; the one-pot recipe failed and the v12 lineage was stopped. V11 remained in use at the time.

lineage.name: migancore:0.13 / v13
lineage.goal: Replace one-pot with three discipline-specific LoRAs, then TIES-merge, so arithmetic, reasoning, and style can be controlled.
lineage.dataMethod: TIES on adapters for arithmetic 283 rows, reasoning 314, style 200; 554 RAG rows excluded. Training on Vast 3×RTX 3090, respective losses 0.946/1.706/1.698; exact cost absent.
lineage.measured: Initial gates: arithmetic 60/60 and 58/60, refusal 9/10, canary 0/12. Evaluation on 23 August: tools 67/90, reasoning 24/42 vs base with `p=0.0117`, old hallucination initially 10/14 then corrected to 9/14; analogy failed. These old instruments are not equivalent to petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: SANAD (chain-of-evidence record) says `LULUS (PASS) R0.3`; adjudication on 10 September says `LULUS SEBAGIAN` because the initial formal verdict was never written and the protocol is obsolete. Replaced by v14.

lineage.name: lora-hitung v13
lineage.goal: “The arithmetic adapter alone fixes ton without colonizing its neighbors.”
lineage.dataMethod: 283 rows, cluster LoRA with the v13 recipe; Vast RTX 3090, loss 0.946. Adapter-specific rank/alpha/cost absent from SANAD (chain-of-evidence record).
lineage.measured: The v13 adapter/merge achieved arithmetic up to 60/60, but component evaluation used the old tier-1 gate; complete per-item solo results are absent from the condensed corpus.
lineage.verdict: Used as a v13 component, then replaced by `hitung-promptragam` in v14; not a separately served model.

lineage.name: lora-nalar v13
lineage.goal: Improve analogy without damaging the base's arithmetic.
lineage.dataMethod: 314 rows; Vast RTX 3090, loss 1.706; specific cost absent.
lineage.measured: In the full v13 evaluation, reasoning 24/42 fell from the base's 33/42, paired McNemar `p=0.0117`; false premise 0/4.
lineage.verdict: Harmful; excluded from the v14 merge and not promoted.

lineage.name: lora-gaya v13
lineage.goal: Enforce role boundaries without damaging arithmetic.
lineage.dataMethod: 200 rows; Vast RTX 3090, loss 1.698; specific cost absent.

lineage.verdict: Passed as a component; original v13 style used in the v14 merge after gaya-promptragam failed. Not a separately served model.

lineage.name: lora-hitung-kontrol23agu / H-kontrol-format2-23agu
lineage.dateAndBase: 23 August 2026; v13 arithmetic adapter on Qwen3 4B with a format-2 I/O contract.
lineage.goal: Reproduce the arithmetic adapter with the patched pipeline to serve as an equivalent comparator for ablation.
lineage.dataMethod: 285 rows (=283+2 teaching examples), identical v13 recipe; Vast, US$0.02, 9 minutes; loss 0.918.
lineage.measured: Passed 10/10 clauses; tier-1 10/10 and 8/10, petak-tahan loss base 3.665→adapter 2.461.
lineage.verdict: **LULUS (PASS)** as a control; not a production candidate.

lineage.name: lora-hitung-wd0.01 / H-wd-0.01
lineage.goal: Weight decay 0.01 was expected to reduce colonization/memorization without eroding arithmetic.
lineage.dataMethod: Same data/recipe as the control, one change `weight_decay=0.01`; Vast. Specific cost not separated; total for the night's three runs US$0.13.
lineage.measured: Identical to control; arithmetic did not decline, ton 4/4, canary 0/12, petak-tahan within tolerance. Calculated shrinkage effect only 0.007%.
lineage.verdict: **LULUS (PASS) without a win = INERT**; wd 0.1 canceled and the path closed.

lineage.name: lora-hitung-epoch1 / H-epoch-1

lineage.dataMethod: Same data/recipe as the control; only epochs `2→1`; Vast. Specific cost not separated from the night's total US$0.13.
lineage.measured: Arithmetic “with” 8/10 failed the threshold, but the “training” arm scored 10/10; sensitivity shifted across prompts rather than disappearing.
lineage.verdict: **GAGAL (FAIL)**; epoch 1 and the recipe-dial path closed, the next lever is varied-prompt data.

lineage.name: lora-hitung-promptragam / H-prompt-ragam
lineage.goal: Rotating the system prompt on the same arithmetic data was expected to eliminate dependence on the prompt/framework.
lineage.dataMethod: 285 rows, A31/G27/P18/N25 rotation, answers/questions/order unchanged; identical v13 recipe, Vast RTX 3090 Ti format-2. Specific cost absent.
lineage.measured: Tier-1 10/10·10/10·10/10 and average 2/2 on all arms.
lineage.verdict: **LULUS (PASS) + MENANG**; became the default v14 data recipe and a component of 0.14k/0.14.

lineage.name: lora-gaya-promptragam / H-gaya-promptragam
lineage.goal: Prompt rotation on 200 style rows was expected to maintain role boundaries without damaging arithmetic.
lineage.dataMethod: 200 rows, 30 with tool lists; identical v13 recipe, only the system prompt rotated. Vast; specific cost absent.
lineage.measured: arit-dengan 7/10 and ton 2/4; arit-tanpa 9/10 and ton 4/4; tolak-ringkas 8/10; canary 0/12.
lineage.verdict: **GAGAL (FAIL)**; excluded from the v14 merge, which uses original v13 style.

lineage.name: hitung-ajar364 (v13 research variant)
lineage.goal: Test whether additional arithmetic teaching improves results with/without context.
lineage.dataMethod: Arithmetic-cluster LoRA, 364 rows = 285 v13 + 79 manual gold; recipe identical to v13. Vast, 7.4 minutes, US$0.03, loss 0.384. A post-run audit found one defective gold row `×1000`; dataset corrected 364→363, but the adapter was not retrained.
lineage.measured: `LULUS + MENANG DOBEL`: with 10/10 (average 2/2), without 10/10 vs control 8/10, training arm 9/10 (average 1/2) vs control 8/10 (0/2), canary 0/12, petak-tahan −1.192; pre-v14 mini instrument, not a modern test battery.

lineage.name: migancore:0.14k
lineage.goal: TIES-merge the varied-prompt arithmetic adapter + style, deliberately excluding the reasoning adapter proven harmful.
lineage.dataMethod: Varied-prompt arithmetic 285 rows with A31/G27/P18/N25 prompt rotation + style 200 rows; TIES-merge. Arithmetic adapter trained on Vast RTX 3090 Ti; specific actual cost absent from SANAD (chain-of-evidence record).
lineage.measured: Old tier-2 gates: arithmetic 60/60 and 59/60, refusal 10/10, canary 0/12, reasoning 29/42, old hallucination 7/14 then corrected to 6/14, tools 79/90, analogy 40/62 failed. This is not petak-jujur2.
lineage.verdict: `LULUS (PASS) H-v14k-tier2-lokal`; an alias for the same weights as `migancore:0.14`, which is currently served.

lineage.name: migancore:0.14
lineage.dateAndBase: Served since 24 August 2026; weights alias `0.14k`, derived from `Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507`.
lineage.goal: Become a general model merged from arithmetic+style without the harmful reasoning adapter.
lineage.dataMethod: Same as 0.14k: TIES-merge LoRA varied-prompt arithmetic 285 + style 200; actual cost absent from the source.
lineage.measured: Historical old tier-2: arithmetic 60/59, refusal 10/10, reasoning 29/42, corrected old hallucination 6/14, tools 79/90. On **petak-jujur2 36 questions**, H4 gives 50.0% fabrication, CI 95% 46.8–53.1, n=13. On **petak-40**, 55.5% was previously recorded; figures are not pooled because the instruments differ.
lineage.verdict: **BERLAKU (SERVED)**; remains served because candidates v15 and v16 failed promotion.

lineage.name: migancore:0.14-tool
lineage.dateAndBase: Branch of 24–25 August 2026; adapter on the v14/4B base.
lineage.goal: A tool-specialist branch, not a successor to the general model.
lineage.dataMethod: Tool-cluster LoRA; final SANAD (chain-of-evidence record) records 389 rows, `r=16`, `alpha=32` on the 4B base. Runs 1–7 changed data/prompts; total costs per run are not summarized. Training on Vast, packaging/evaluation locally/on VPS.
lineage.measured: run-3 was once best on the **old tool test**, 91/120; run-7 86/120 and run-6 81/120. The run-3 hallucination headline `2/14` was an old-instrument result corrected to 4/14. On **petak-jujur2 36 questions**, H4 later recorded 26.8%, CI 95% 24.1–29.5, n=6, but the 600-second timeout differs from 0.14's 120 seconds, limiting direct comparison.
lineage.verdict: Specialist branch; never replaced 0.14 and now archived/a special-purpose service, not the served model. No separate final promotion pre-registration in BERLAKU (SERVED).

lineage.name: migancore:0.14-tool-8b
lineage.goal: Test whether 8B capacity clears the tool gate with the same tool data/recipe.
lineage.dataMethod: 201 rows of run-7 data, same LoRA recipe except for the 8B base. Trained on Vast; creation/serving moved to VPS because of disk constraints. Exact cost absent.
lineage.measured: On the **old tool test**, 8B baseline 87/120 and candidate 97/120, failed threshold 99; missing-tool category 7/20. Old regression gates: arithmetic 60/60, refusal 9/10, canary 0/12; hallucination initially 13/14 then corrected to 12/14. The server record of 12,224 seconds per response was later corrected as a hardware problem; the laptop reached 18.6 tok/s, VPS CPU around 0.016 tok/s.
lineage.verdict: Failed the tool threshold and performed poorly on hallucination; research archive, **barred from promotion**.

lineage.name: migancore:0.15-tool

lineage.goal: Test whether a larger volume of tool data increases tool success without damaging regression gates.

lineage.name: migancore:uji-jujur-1 / V16-JUJUR
lineage.goal: Reduce the tendency to fabricate with 33 handwritten honesty gold examples, without damaging arithmetic/tools; the name `0.16` is assigned only upon a win.
lineage.dataMethod: TIES-merge varied-prompt arithmetic 285 + gaya-jujur1 233 (=200 v13 style + 33 gold); style LoRA `r=16`, `alpha=32`, `lr=2e-4`, 2 epochs. Vast RTX 3090: training 13 minutes/US$0.04, merge 51 minutes/US$0.16.
lineage.measured: **petak-40**: candidate 60.0% vs 0.14 55.5%, Welch `t=1.62`, not significant; factual score 10.2 vs 11.2. **Regression gates**: arithmetic 59/60, refusal 10/10, canary 0/12; **current tool gate** 19/24 vs 18/24. All gates passed, but the MENANG fabrication threshold ≤50% failed.
lineage.verdict: **TIDAK MENANG (NOT A WIN)**; archived, barred from promotion; `migancore:0.14` remains served.

lineage.name: V17-RLVR / migancore:uji-rlvr-1
lineage.dateAndBase: 31 August–1 September 2026; Qwen3 4B base with a style adapter, then RLVR/MO-GRPO.
lineage.goal: Teach honesty through verifiable rewards, then test whether petak-40 improves without regression.
lineage.dataMethod: Pool of 36 prompts: 10 “nonexistent”, 8 false premises, 6 out of scope, 12 factual questions. MO-GRPO LoRA `r=16`, `alpha=32`, `lr=5e-6`, 8 generations, temperature 0.8, beta 0.04; length trimmed 256→128 and accumulation adjusted during the run. Vast; total cost US$1.96.

lineage.verdict: **BELUM DIVONIS (NOT YET JUDGED)**; hypothesis remains open and promotion is prohibited.

lineage.name: MO-GRPO run series (six adapters)
lineage.dateAndBase: Pre-registration 28 August 2026; v14/v15 tool base according to adapter name.
lineage.goal: Assess whether MO-GRPO can optimize tools/honesty with multiple rewards; the sub-goal is to see which objectives actually produce gradients.
lineage.dataMethod: Pool of 361 prompts; MO-GRPO with a locked budget ≤US$0.50. Six artifacts: `lora-gaya-rlvr1` (20 steps/5,760 rollouts), `tool-grpo-diag` (3/768), `diag2` (2/512), `jujur-probe` (2/128), `jujur` (20/5,760), `waktu` (3/768). Vast infrastructure; actual costs per run absent.
lineage.measured: In the training logs, repeatedly active objectives are takUlang 61.8–68.8% and jujur 47.5–50%; behavior, format, and content are inactive (variance 0) in runs with logs. None of the six sets of weights underwent post-training model evaluation; `jujur-probe` does not even have an objective summary.
lineage.verdict: Main question **TIDAK BISA DIVONIS (CANNOT BE JUDGED)**; six sets of weights unmeasured.
